schema.text: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to make long trips where you must be sure of getting back?

ar.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون سيارة، هل تتخلى عن المحاولة أو تجد صعوبة بالغة في القيام برحلات طويلة تحتاج فيها إلى التأكد من العودة؟

de.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Verzichten Sie ohne Auto darauf oder fällt es Ihnen sehr schwer, lange Fahrten zu machen, bei denen Sie sicher sein müssen, wieder zurückzukommen?

en.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Without a car, do you give up trying or find it very hard to make long trips where you must be sure of getting back?

fa.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: بدون خودرو، آیا از تلاش دست می‌کشید یا برایتان خیلی سخت است که سفرهای طولانی بروید که باید مطمئن باشید برمی‌گردید؟

fr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Sans voiture, renoncez-vous à essayer ou trouvez-vous très difficile de faire de longs trajets pour lesquels vous devez avoir la certitude de pouvoir rentrer ?

hu.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Autó nélkül lemond arról, vagy nagyon nehéznek találja, hogy hosszú utakat megtenni, ahol biztosnak kell lennie a hazajutásban?

it.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Senza auto, rinunci o fai molta fatica a fare viaggi lunghi in cui devi essere certo di tornare?

tr.#Without a car, do you give up trying or: Arabanız olmadan, geri dönebileceğinizden emin olmanız gereken uzun yolculuklar yapmaktan vazgeçiyor veya bunu çok zor buluyor musunuz?
